prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, 3-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in yamanba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big neon-acrylic hoop and a small silver star stud.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 3 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent soft pink rose quartz, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 3 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): carved solid golden-brown tiger's eye with a silky chatoyant band, completely opaque. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque. Band 3 (both thigh-stubs, a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be): carved solid dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque, rounding off at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a hot neon pink on one side and a bright electric cyan on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so pink light glances off one side and cyan light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
